answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases therefore burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the relic deposit is held in the saffron escrow, the thread audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 83 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 36 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
